verdict.rationale: Check documents its own benefits object, which captures benefit types, start and end dates, and employee and company contributions for payroll. Its marketing also lists "Health benefits" and "Deductions". That covers the deduction-to-payroll side of the story. Nothing in the pack shows Check offering health insurance plans or running employee enrollment workflows. missing for 10: offering or sourcing health insurance plans, enrollment flows and open-enrollment administration, carrier sync, detailed docs on how benefit deductions apply in payroll runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll

citations.quote: Use the benefits object to capture benefit types, start and end dates, and employee and company contributions.
